title: Directional accessibility signage.
officialText:
Directional signage shall be provided in accordance with Section 1110.2 at or in close
proximity to inaccessible building entrances, inaccessible public toilets and bathing facilities, and elevators not serving an accessible
route indicating the route to the nearest like accessible element where such accessible element is provided, such that a person with
disabilities will not be required to retrace the approach route from the inaccessible element.
